newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria junior agriculture minister dies of asthma.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria junior agriculture minister dies of asthma.

text.p: Nigeria's minister of state for agriculture, Ademola Adesina, has died after a protracted battle against asthma, officials said on Monday.
They said Adesina died in the capital Abuja on Saturday at the age of 54.

The semi-official Daily Times newspaper reported on Monday that Adesina suffered a bout of asthma after returning from an official assignment in northeastern Nigeria and was taken to the presidential clinic, where he died a few minutes later.
Until his appointment as minister in March 1995, Adesina was a professor of architecture at Ladoke Akintola University in his home state of Oyo in southwestern Nigeria.
